verdict.rationale: Firstbase's registered agent service page says it tracks compliance requirements and deadlines and will file all annual reports and franchise tax reports on the founder's behalf, which is a managed annual-report service. A compliance dashboard shows each state's deadlines, and pricing of $299 per state per year appears on the same page. Community posts confirm annual reports are a real obligation (e.g. Wyoming) but do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on what preparation is included and whether state fees are covered, an explicit link between the $299 price and annual-report filing, and independent hands-on corroboration that Firstbase files the reports.

support.subject: As a founder, I can have the provider prepare and file my annual reports as a managed service or add-on

citations.quote: we'll file all annual reports and franchise tax reports on your behalf!
Click on a state to view requirements, upcoming deadlines, and take any necessary actions.
